text: Masisi o dira tiro e molemo mo pusong
BDP e tsweletse ka thulaganyo e e siameng
Palamente e dirile ditshwetso tse di siameng
Batswana ba itumelela kgolo ya ikonomi
Mmuso o thusa batho ka mananeo a thuto
The government is doing excellent work for development
I love how Botswana maintains peace and stability
BDP's policies are really helping the economy grow
Masisi's leadership brings hope to batho
Parliament passed good laws for ditshwanelo
Mmuso o paletswe ke go rarabolola mathata
Boferefere bo ntse bo le teng mo pusong
Batho ba hutsafetse ka maemo a ikonomi
Palamente ga e dire sepe go thusa setšhaba
The government has failed batho badly
Corruption is destroying our beautiful country
I'm disappointed with the current leadership
BDP policies are causing more mathata for people
Politicians only care about themselves, not batho
Palamente e kopane gompieno go sekaseka molao
Masisi o ne a bua ka thulaganyo ya naga
BDP le UDC ba tla kopana mo kgotleng
Batswana ba tla tlhopha mo dikgetholong
Mmuso o tla itsise ka tshwetso ya bone
